proposal: Move the statements of Lemmas 7.2-7.6 (lem:teacher:list, floor, coding, twopart, sharpfloor) and the F^sharp display to App E, keeping one summary paragraph.
reason: Not adopted in this round. The instance and its lemmas are shared by §7-§9, PLAN §7.4 places them in the main text, and nearly every proof idea of §7 and §8 cites (D1), (D2) or the sharp floor by number. The §7 target of 3.8 pp is to be reached by trims (RW4-03). This is the first candidate if the main-text cap of 33.5 pp is still exceeded after this round, and it needs the author's decision.

proposal: Move prop:parity:range (i)(e)-(g) and (ii) to App E.
reason: Rejected. It would change the fixed item structure of prop:parity:range (PLAN §3.6), which other groups and the introduction cite as (ii) and (iii). The proposition is the certified λ-range result of the parity section.

proposal: Move §8.4 wholesale (Propositions 8.12-8.13 with their definitions) to App F with a half-page summary; move prop:teacher:schedules(c) and tab:teacher:numbers to App F.
reason: Adopted in part. Only prop:teacher:sharp moves, with the Floor/Psi/LB display (RW5-04). prop:teacher:rates stays in the main text, because it carries the asymptotic threshold below p_1 that the abstract and the introduction state. tab:teacher:numbers is the illustration of Theorem C that the introduction quotes. prop:teacher:schedules(c) is the schedule result that tab:discussion:reasons cites.

proposal: Move cor:recovery:noisy and its paragraph to App D with a three-line summary.
reason: Rejected. Noisy computable functions (f plus noise, with the rate identified exactly) are the canonical example of the first reason. The frozen-table numbers of the paragraph after it move to App D instead (D4, RW3-04).

proposal: Move §6.7 (thm:split:lambda1, the tape-length paragraph, the Eisenstat/SI paragraph) to App D, keeping a short summary.
reason: Adopted in part. thm:split:lambda1 is the motivating result of the first reason (λ = 1 on one data set). It is cited in the second paragraph of the introduction, in tab:discussion:reasons, in §8 and in the acknowledgements (via sec:split:lambda1), so it stays. Only the paragraph after it is reduced to one sentence, with its details in App D (RW3-05).

proposal: Move lem:setup:hull (v),(vi) to App A as a separate appendix lemma.
reason: Rejected. Splitting the labelled lemma would change the item references lem:setup:hull(v),(vi), which W2, W3, W6 and Theorem B (informal) use, and it would need a new label. The saving is 0.2 pp; §3 reaches its target through RW1-01.
Rejected. The item structure (a)-(c) is fixed (PLAN §3.6), and the saving is about 0.1 pp.

proposal: Move the correspondence table of App H to the repository README; delete prop:algstat:coarse, rem:algstat:near1, q:algstat:lsc, ex:teacher:version1 and prop:teacher:concentration from the appendices.
reason: Rejected. These are proved results, an open question, or the credit for the earlier report, whose results are re-derived (DECISIONS §A4; REFRAME §4). No proved result is deleted; the appendix cap is set to 37.5 pp instead (DECISIONS-restructure §3). Deleting them needs the author's decision.

proposal: Move the computed numbers (0.199/0.274 at c = 10^-4) out of the italic statement of Theorem C (informal) into the next paragraph.
reason: Rejected. DECISIONS §F29 put these numbers in the informal teacher theorem as exact text, and the informal theorem is a paragraph, not a theorem-like environment (DECISIONS §A9 concerns those). The rest of the finding is accepted (RF-04): the rounding (0.200; 3.65·10^-3) and the forward reference ("the sizes given below").

proposal: Keep only rows 1, 5, 7, 8 of tab:intro:claims, or move the table to §11 next to tab:discussion:reasons.
reason: Adopted in part. Only the row "What does λ = 1 do?" is deleted, because tab:discussion:reasons carries it (RF-05). The rows on separating a sampler from its fill-ins, the change of slope and the growth of the length coefficient are the questions the two reasons answer, and the change of slope is one of the questions that motivate the paper.

proposal: Delete the semimeasure-convention sentence of the 'Conventions' paragraph as a duplicate of Definition 3.4 (def:setup:shared).
reason: Rejected as a duplicate removal. The normalised convention (normalising by the sum over y') is stated only in the conventions paragraph, not in def:setup:shared. FRONT may still shorten the paragraph (RF-05, optional).

proposal: Add "λ = 1 included; a fixed λ > 1 adds a sample size ..." to the abstract.
reason: Not adopted. The new abstract (D9) is at the 1920-character limit, and λ = 1 is already covered by "for every 1 ≤ λ_n = o(n)".

Accepted with a modified text. D9 is the lead editor's version. The reviewer's text keeps "samples have such a kink", contrary to its own m6, and omits "dyadic" (prop:parity:range(iii)); D9 fixes both and keeps M3, m1, m2 and m17(a).

proposal: In def:teacher:instance(c), restrict B globally to ∞ or an integer ≥ log(1/p).
reason: Accepted with a modified fix (D6). The restriction applies only where (D2) of lem:teacher:twopart is used: prop:teacher:kinks, thm:teacher:main, cor:teacher:sampled, and through them prop:teacher:sharp(iii) and prop:teacher:concentration. lem:teacher:floor, lem:teacher:sharpfloor, (D1), prop:limits:plain(b) and lem:teacher:finite keep real B, since their proofs do not code B.

proposal: Either relax the caps to main ≤ 32 and appendices ≤ 34, or keep 27/27/57 and cut.
reason: Accepted with modified numbers. The new caps are main ≤ 33.5, appendices ≤ 37.5 and total ≤ 73.5, with ordered moves and trims (DECISIONS-restructure §3). The moves add about 2 pp to the appendices, and no proved result is removed. Reaching 27/27/57 would need about 18 pp of cuts of proved material; that is the author's decision, not the editors'.
